newsitem.title: GERMANY: Adidas shares strongly ahead in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Adidas shares strongly ahead in late trade.

text.p: German sportswear maker Adidas AG continued a strong performance over the course of trade on Thursday and was among the top performing shares on the IBIS DAX index in late trade.
Adidas was up 5.90 marks, 3.32 percent, at 183.80 marks in late bourse trade, outperforming the overall IBIS DAX-30 index which was down 21.77 points, or 0.65 percent, at 3,342.99 points.
The rise in the share came after Adidas reported a 43 percent increase in first-quarter 1997 sales to 1.7 billion marks.
The strength of the dollar against the mark, at around 1.71 marks, was also supporting the share.
